subject: Outstanding items: Meridian Fabrication document requests
body:
Hi David,

I'm following up on the items below. Our records show we have not yet received them:

- Updated financial projections following our April 2024 call on the automotive order decline (first requested April 10, 2024)
- Updated 12-month cash flow projections with assumptions stated (first requested January 18, 2025)
- Signed management representation letter for the Q4 2024 covenant package (first requested January 21, 2025)
- Updated accounts receivable aging report (first requested January 21, 2025)
- Aerospace contract purchase order documentation (first requested January 23, 2025)
- Customer names on the 60-90 day accounts receivable items (first requested January 31, 2025)
- Q1 2025 covenant compliance package (first requested March 14, 2025)

Please reply with the date you expect to send these. If something is holding any of them up, let's set a short call this week to work through it together.

Thanks,
Sarah
